name: Kinetic Punch
summary: The creator edit: word-by-word pop captions (heavy all-caps, thick outline, live word lit, money in green), punch-in jump cuts on every caption group, flash + zoom transitions, progress bar, sticker CTA.
lexicon: karaoke highlight on the active word
best_for: talking heads, street demos, reaction and tutorial B-roll — anything spoken fast to a cold audience
footage: full-bleed, subject centred in the upper half; punch-ins crop 14%, so shoot or generate at 1080x1920 or larger
music: upbeat trap / phonk / pop instrumental, 120-150 BPM, ducked well under the voice
sfx: one whoosh on each zoom transition, one pop on the hook sticker — never on every word
